Use case: photorealistic-natural.
Asset type: finished photographic background for IRAN SAM youth football academy website, for ages 6–15.
Reference image 1 is ONLY a look/architecture/kit reference storyboard. Reference image 2 is the EXACT final logo. Create ONE standalone photographic scene with no panels, no borders, no collage, no contact sheet.
Architecture continuity: the same contemporary modest indoor FUTSAL academy seen in reference 1: blue hard court with credible straight white lines, gray exposed steel roof trusses, long clerestory windows, offwhite plaster, deep navy lower walls, warm orange doors. Real small futsal hall, NOT outdoor, NOT stadium, NOT luxury mansion.
Premium sports campaign photograph. Natural late-afternoon daylight, cinematic but believable contrast, rich navy and orange colors, tactile real materials, subtle authentic wear. Photorealistic optical perspective and natural shadows, no CGI or render appearance. Preserve visible midtone detail; website applies its own dark overlay.
Brand marks, only when specified, must match EXACT reference 2: navy segmented ball with white Iran silhouette and orange upper-right segment; small exact wordmark "IRAN SAM". No invented logos, no other brands. Mark must be physically embroidered/printed on real material.
Absolutely no people, bodies, faces, UI, interface, buttons, headline, caption, promotional overlay text, watermark, or decorative extra graphics.
Primary request: bold dramatic editorial macro close view of one navy youth-size V-neck football jersey hanging naturally on a wooden hanger inside an open navy locker. Approved navy mesh jersey, orange V-neck and orange cuff trim, subtle white piping; exact small ball/Iran crest plus IRAN SAM at wearer's left chest. Highly realistic mesh perforations, embroidery, seams and draped fabric, no person or mannequin.
Composition: LANDSCAPE 1536x1024. Jersey fills LEFT half, collar at upper-left/upper middle, crest clearly within left half. Camera close enough for premium garment texture; part of cuff visible. RIGHT 45% is calm dark defocused navy locker shadow, spacious and visually uninterrupted for Persian webpage overlay. Important collar/crest comfortably inset from image edges. Single photograph, not storyboard.
